explanation.title: What drives this score
explanation.empty: Add a normalized input, meaningful activity, or success goal to calculate health.

breakdown.title: Dimension breakdown
breakdown.description: Available dimensions are normalized across their configured weights. Missing inputs are excluded, never scored as zero.

history.title: Health history
history.description: Reproducible assessments from the latest 90 days.
history.chartLabel: Customer health score over time from zero to one hundred
history.summary: {count, plural, one {# assessment} other {# assessments}} shown, from {first} to {latest} points.

inputs.title: Health inputs
inputs.description: Record normalized evidence from 0 to 100. Usage and support are manual or explicitly simulated in V1; engagement and goals can return to Waslix system values.

validation.invalid: Enter a value from 0 to 100 and a valid observation date.
